SPAN_DERIVATION_MIN.justification: the engine's own span-derivation rule (candidate_diversity.span_derivation_check): ratio < 0.20 = SPAN_UNDERIVED. A MECHANISM_STRENGTHENING mutation must CLEAR this floor — the same rule that gates the grid, not a new one.

EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_MIN.justification: I1's underived flag fires below 0.20; an EVIDENCE_DERIVED_CONSTRAINT mutation must clear the same floor on evidence_support.

DOMAIN_OVERLAP_MIN.justification: REPLAY_CACHE re-adjudication is valid only while the mutated candidate stays in the domain the cached art was found FOR. Guard: >= 1 NON-generic technical term shared between the child's mechanism+intervention and the cached family corpus. ZERO overlap means the mutation abandoned the domain (measured attack: re-adjudicating a cement-curing intervention against battery art fabricates surviving differentiators — false novelty from stale art). The overlap count is RECORDED on every cache adjudication so thin-domain links are auditable. NOTE: entity-term retention vs the problem CANNOT catch this class — entity terms are problem-derived and unchanged by mutations (measured while writing the guard's tests); it is recorded for audit only.

MAX_ITERATIONS_DEFAULT.justification: the CEO minimum loop is DIAGNOSE -> IMPROVE -> RE-EVALUATE -> IMPROVE AGAIN; two iterations demonstrate repeatability at bounded cost

MAX_PROPOSALS_PER_ITERATION.justification: bounded proposal budget: three attempts, then the honest no-defensible-mutation verdict

fields.INTERVENTION: Increase the operating pressure of the fuel cell stack while maintaining current density at 1.5 A/cm² and stack temperature at 80°C, with pressure differential between anode and cathode maintained at 20 kPa
fields.EXPECTED_EFFECT: Reduced membrane dehydration, lower ionic resistance, minimized hot spot formation, and maintained power output without significantly increasing cathode humidification load due to reduced water vapor partial pressure proportion

fields.EXPERIMENT: Compare membrane hydration state and ionic resistance at 1.5 A/cm² current density and 80°C stack temperature with 20 kPa anode-cathode pressure differential against the baseline of equal pressure at both electrodes
fields.CONSTRAINT_DERIVED: Maintain anode-cathode pressure differential of 20 kPa
fields.MUTATION_REASON: Repairs I1_MECHANISM_EVIDENCE_DERIVATION weakness by anchoring mechanism in evidence-derived technical vocabulary about reduced proportion of water vapor partial pressure in total gas pressure

fields.MECHANISM: Increasing pressure reduces the proportion of water vapor partial pressure in the total gas pressure, which mitigates the impacts of temperature and humidity on membrane dehydration while improving cell performance and enhancing stack consistency

fields.EXPECTED_EFFECT: Reduced membrane dehydration, lower ionic resistance, minimized hot spot formation, and maintained power output without significantly increasing cathode humidification load due to the reduced proportion of water vapor partial pressure in the total gas pressure
